title: Bulk Re-Validation
description: Single CLI/UI operations: re-run all stale tuples for a golden, or re-run a single skill across all goldens. Concurrency limits to avoid agent-manager queue saturation.

requirements.title: Bulk orchestrator + concurrency control
requirements.description: Service that fans out validation runs respecting a configured concurrency cap (default low, e.g. 2). Surfaces estimated cost (sum of historical baselines) before kick-off; allows abort.
